key_insight: VISTA Architect precomputes a provenance-linked clinical knowledge graph and timeline so LLMs can answer EHR questions faster and more accurately than repeatedly reprocessing raw records.
clinical_relevance: In multidisciplinary tumor boards, it helps reconstruct complex patient histories with high fidelity, supporting faster preparation and more reliable clinical summarization.
method: Builds a source-faithful MEDS Graph that preserves granular EHR structure and provenance.
Derives a clinically abstracted Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) using graph-guided LLM extraction to deduplicate and align events temporally.
Uses an agentic interface to traverse from summarized patient state back to source documentation for verification when needed.
evidence_signal: Across 1,180 patients and 17,700 variable-level evaluations, the system achieved 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10; 95% CI 96.1–96.7%) on 15 tumor board-salient variables, outperforming a BM25 RAG baseline.
watch_item: Results were demonstrated in thoracic oncology only, so broader clinical generalization and workflow integration still need validation.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
